title: Framed localization spectrum charts for affine-basis graded line maps
statement: Let $h:T\to S$ be a morphism of schemes, $A$ affine-basis graded algebra data on $S$ [def-trf-relative-graded-line-map], and $L$ an $\mathcal O_T$-module. A framed fraction-chart index consists of affine opens $U\subset S$ and $W\subset h^{-1}U$, a section $l\in\Gamma(W,L)$ that is a free generator [def-sc-local-free-generator], a positive integer $d$, and an element $e\in A(U)_d$. A coefficient family $c$ assigns an element of $\mathcal O_T(W)$ to every affine $U,W$, inclusion $W\subset h^{-1}U$, section $l$, degree $n$, and $a\in A(U)_n$. For an index $i$ put $b_i=c_{U,W,l}(e)$ and $X_i=\operatorname{Spec}(\mathcal O_T(W)[1/b_i])$. Define $s_i:X_i\to T$ by the localization spectrum map followed by the affine chart map for $W$. Given ring maps $\rho_i:(A(U)_{e})_0\to\mathcal O_T(W)[1/b_i]$, define $t_i:X_i\to\operatorname{Proj}_S(A)$ by their spectrum maps followed by the standard homogeneous-localization chart and the affine-base chart embedding [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero]. The fraction formula means $\rho_i(a/e^n)=c_{U,W,l}(a)/b_i^n$ for all $n\ge0$ and $a\in A(U)_{nd}$.
